mythos_design_patterns.description: Quick-reference index for Iris to understand available patterns

P1_ontology_node.purpose: Named entities with canonical_id bridge to Postgres
P1_ontology_node.key_rule: Every node MUST have canonical_id (UUID), at least one name, created_at, source

P2_relationship_web.key_rule: Use specific types, never generic RELATED_TO. Edges carry properties.

P3_schema_aware_node.purpose: Self-describing graph — Schema nodes define expected properties and relationships
P3_schema_aware_node.key_rule: Every node type gets a :Schema node. Update when properties change.
P3_schema_aware_node.introspection_query: MATCH (s:Schema) RETURN s.node_type, s.required_properties, s.valid_outgoing, s.example_queries ORDER BY s.node_type

P4_conversation_log.purpose: Chat messages, conversation containers, tiered summaries
key_rules: Messages are IMMUTABLE — never UPDATE content
Embeddings stored as vector(384) via pgvector
Transactions are IMMUTABLE — corrections are new transactions
SHA256 fingerprint for dedup on import

P6_media_asset.purpose: Photos, audio, documents — metadata only, files on disk
key_rules: Binary data lives on DISK, not in database
Vision analysis fields populated async by workers
canonical_id is the ONLY cross-DB key
Never use Neo4j id() or Postgres serial as bridge
Same UUID appears in both databases for the same entity

P8_worker_pipeline.purpose: Async enrichment — intake fast, process later
key_rules: Use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for parallel workers
Mark processed=TRUE only when ALL workers done

conventions.ids: UUID everywhere via uuid_generate_v4() (Postgres) or randomUUID() (Neo4j)
conventions.timestamps: TIMESTAMPTZ in Postgres, datetime() in Neo4j, always UTC
conventions.source_tracking: Every record has a source field: manual | import | channeled | inferred | api
conventions.immutability: Logs (messages, transactions) are NEVER updated. Corrections are new records.
conventions.spiral_time: spiral_number (which 9-day cycle) + spiral_day (1-9 within cycle) tracked on time-sensitive records

for_iris.session_startup: Run P3 introspection query to see current schema. Check what node types and relationship types exist before building anything.
for_iris.before_building: Check which pattern fits. Don't reinvent existing patterns.
for_iris.new_feature: If no pattern fits, create new one following the same format and add to this index.
